services.name: guided kayak trip
services.desc: Single Guided Kayak Trip for up to 3 People. 1/2 and Full day trips available nearly year round Join seasoned guide Josh Rayner for a one-of-a kind kayak fishing trip in Connecticut! Choose how many people are in your party (3 max.) and choose from a 5 hour (1/2 day) or 9 hour (Full day) trip. Each client will be equipped with their own very comfortable, stable, well maintained, and easy to use pedal driven Hobie Outback, the appropriate fishing gear, safety gear, and foul weather gear for the trip, as well as bottled waters and snacks. You can also choose from a list of target species and habitats (freshwater or saltwater) depending on the season and what is biting (Location TBD). Come
